x-m-el-res-05.title: An Yi Nasara Sau 40, Shin Har Yanzu Zai Iya Zama Kuskure?
x-m-el-res-05.topic: Misalan da ke karyata ƙa’ida da binciken kuskure
x-m-el-res-05.goal: Ka nemo misali da kanka da zai karyata ƙa’ida, domin ka ga cewa ko ƙa’idar da aka gwada sau da yawa tana iya karyewa da misali guda, sannan ka bayyana bambancin gwaji da tabbatarwa.
x-m-el-res-05.material: Ka saka n = 1, 2, 3, …, 10 a cikin n² − n + 41 (n murabba’i a cire n a ƙara 41), ka samu 41, 43, 47, 53, 61, 71, 83, 97, 113, 131, kuma duk lambobin firimi ne. Wani ɗalibi ya ce, “Ga kowane lambar halitta n, n² − n + 41 lambar firimi ce.”
x-m-el-res-05.prereq.0: Ma’anar lambar firimi (lambar halitta mai aƙalla 2 wadda masu rabonta kaɗai su ne 1 da ita kanta)
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.prompt: Daga sakamakon gwajin n = 1 zuwa 10, wace jimla ce ta fi dacewa a faɗa?
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bambance ko jimla tana magana ne game da “iyakar abin da aka gwada” ko “dukkan lokuta.”
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko akwai ƙimomin n da ba ka gwada ba tukuna.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.o.a: Dukkan goma sun yi daidai, don haka za mu iya ɗauka cewa ya dace da kowane n
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa gwada lokuta da yawa daidai yake da gwada dukkan lokuta.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.o.b: Dukkan goma lambobin firimi ne, don haka kusan babu yiwuwar samun misalin da zai karyata
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka sauya kalmar zuwa “yiwuwa,” amma akwai ƙimomin n marasa iyaka da ba a gwada ba.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.o.c: Har sai an sami lambar da ba firimi ba, za mu iya cewa wannan dabara daidai ce
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.r.c: Rashin samun misalin da ke karyata tukuna ya bambanta da kasancewa gaskiya koyaushe.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.o.d: An gwada n = 1 zuwa 10 kawai, kuma manyan n ba a gwada ba tukuna
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunanin bambance yankin da aka gwada da wanda ba a gwada ba ne.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s1.explain: Za ka iya cewa yana aiki a yankin da aka gwada kawai (n = 1 zuwa 10). Ba a gwada sauran n ba, saboda haka har yanzu ba a sani ba ko yana aiki ga “duk n.”
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.prompt: Nemo lambobin halitta n guda 2 daban-daban waɗanda n²−n+41 ba lambar firimi ba ce.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sake rubuta n²−n+41 a matsayin n(n−1)+41.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda n(n−1) ya kamata ya kasance domin ƙimar ta zama ninkin 41.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.fail.c1: n dole ne ya zama lambar halitta aƙalla 1.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.ok.c2: n²−n+41 ba lambar firimi ba ce.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.fail.c2: n²−n+41 lambar firimi ce. Ba zai iya zama misalin da ke karyata ƙa’ida ba.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.explain: Idan n = 41, to 41² − 41 + 41 = 41² = 1681, wanda ba lambar firimi ba ce. Idan n = 42, to 1763 = 41 × 43. Ko da yawancin lokutan baya sun yi daidai, misali guda yana karya ikirarin “duk n.”
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa gaskiyar cewa n = 1 zuwa 40 duk lambobin firimi ne ba ta nuna cewa “ga kowane n lambar firimi ce” ba.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin misalai nawa ake buƙata domin a karya kalmar “kowane.”
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Kwatanta adadin n da ka gwada da adadin dukkan lambobin halitta.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Bayyanarka ta faɗi bambancin “abin da aka gwada” da “abin da aka tabbatar” kuwa?
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka ambaci ƙarfin misali guda da ke karyata kuwa?
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Misali guda da ke karyata ya isa ya sa ikirarin “ga duk n” ya zama kuskure, don haka gwada lokuta 40 ba ya ba mu damar cewa sauran n ma sun dace.
x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Akwai lambobin halitta marasa iyaka, amma wasu kaɗan ne kawai aka gwada; saboda haka mai yiwuwa sauran n ɗin da ba a gwada ba ba su dace ba.

x-m-el-res-03.thinking.0: Nemo mafita da dama bisa sharuddan
x-m-el-res-03.title: Dalibai Nawa Daga Kowace Shekara Ya Kamata Mu Bincika?
x-m-el-res-03.goal: Ka yanke shawara da kanka yadda za a raba adadin mutanen samfurin tsakanin ƙungiyoyin da suka bambanta girma, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
x-m-el-res-03.material: Makaranta tana da ɗalibai 120 na shekara ta 1, 100 na shekara ta 2, da 80 na shekara ta 3, jimilla 300. Kana son bincika gamsuwar ɗalibai da abincin makaranta, kana son bincikar ɗalibai 30 gaba ɗaya. An ce ya dace a zaɓi ɗalibai daga kowace shekara gwargwadon kaso na ɗaliban shekarar a makaranta, amma ka yanke shawarar cewa bisa yanayin da ake ciki, kuskuren har mutum 1 daga adadin gwargwado abin karɓa ne.
x-m-el-res-03.thinking.1: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa wakilcin jama’a yake da muhimmanci.
x-m-el-res-03.prereq.0: Lissafin kaso da rabo (matakin makarantar tsakiya)
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka binciki ɗalibai 10 daga kowace shekara, wace yiwuwar ɗalibi guda daga duk makarantar zai kasance cikin waɗanda aka zaɓa?
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace shekara, kwatanta “adadin waɗanda aka zaɓa ÷ jimillar ɗaliban shekarar.”
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko, kwatanta ɗaliban aji na 1 da na aji na 3.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.o.a: Makarantun dukkan aji uku iri ɗaya ne
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa idan adadin waɗanda aka zaɓa iri ɗaya ne, damar zaɓuwa ma iri ɗaya ce. Kana kuma buƙatar duba jimillar ɗaliban kowane aji.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.o.b: Ɗaliban aji na 1 suna da babbar dama
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.r.b: Ka duba adadin waɗanda aka zaɓa kawai, ba ka lura da rabonsa da jimillar ɗaliban ajin ba.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.o.c: Ɗaliban aji na 3 suna da babbar dama
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunanin kwatanta adadin waɗanda aka zaɓa da jimillar ɗaliban ajin ne.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.o.d: Idan adadin ɗaliban azuzuwan ya bambanta, ba za a iya lissafawa ba
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.r.d: Ko da adadin ya bambanta, za ka iya kwatantawa ta amfani da “adadin waɗanda aka zaɓa ÷ jimillar ajin.”
x-m-el-res-03.s.s1.explain: A aji na 3, 10 cikin 80 ne (ɗaya bisa takwas); a aji na 1 kuwa, 10 cikin 120 ne (ɗaya bisa goma sha biyu). Saboda haka ɗalibin aji na 3 ya fi samun damar zaɓuwa. Idan aka raba adadin daidai, wakilcin kowane aji zai bambanta.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.prompt: Ka ƙirƙiri hanyoyi 3 daban-daban na rabawa, ta yadda jimillar waɗanda aka zaɓa za ta zama 30. (Bambanci da adadin da ya dace da kaso ya zama mutum 1 ko ƙasa da haka ga kowane aji.)
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko, nemo kaso na jimillar ɗalibai da kowane aji yake wakilta.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.hint.1: Fara da adadin da ake samu idan aka yi amfani da wannan kaso ga mutum 30, sannan a ƙara ko a rage mutum 1 a aji guda.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Adadin ya zama cikakken lamba mai aƙalla 0.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne adadin ya zama cikakken lamba mai aƙalla 0.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar adadin azuzuwan uku ba ta kai 30 ba.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Adadin aji na 1 ya dace da ma’aunin kaso.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Adadin aji na 1 ya bambanta da mutum 2 ko fiye da adadin da ya dace da kaso na ɗalibai.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Adadin aji na 2 ya dace da ma’aunin kaso.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Adadin aji na 2 ya bambanta da mutum 2 ko fiye da adadin da ya dace da kaso na ɗalibai.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.ok.c5: Adadin aji na 3 ya dace da ma’aunin kaso.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.fail.c5: Adadin aji na 3 ya bambanta da mutum 2 ko fiye da adadin da ya dace da kaso na ɗalibai.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.explain: Rabon ɗalibai 120 : 100 : 80 ne, wato 6 : 5 : 4. Saboda haka idan aka raba mutum 30, ma’auni ya zama 12 : 10 : 8. An kuma yarda da rabon da ya ƙara ko ya rage mutum 1 daga nan.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Idan aka kwatanta da zaɓen mutum 10 daga kowane aji, ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa rabawa bisa adadin ɗalibai ya fi kyau.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin tasirin ɗalibi guda a aji mai ƙarancin ɗalibai ga sakamakon gaba ɗaya, idan aka zaɓi mutum 10 daga kowane aji.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka bayyana “yana wakiltar gaba ɗaya” da kalmominka.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Bayyanarka ta haɗa da bambancin adadin ɗaliban kowane aji?
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana wane aji ne ra’ayinsa ya fi bayyana a sakamakon idan aka zaɓi mutum 10 daga kowane aji?
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan aka zaɓi mutum 10 daga kowane aji, ra’ayoyin ɗaliban aji na 3, wanda yake da ƙarancin ɗalibai, za su fi bayyana a sakamakon gaba ɗaya, don haka sakamakon na iya karkata gefe guda. Daidaita adadin da yawan ɗalibai yana rage wannan karkata.
x-m-el-res-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Sai idan rabon ya dace da adadin ɗalibai ne damar zaɓuwa ga dukkan ɗalibai take kusan iri ɗaya, ta yadda sakamakon zai wakilci makarantar gaba ɗaya.

x-m-el-res-01.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ko bayanin da ake da shi ya wadatar
x-m-el-res-01.title: Mayar da “Amfani da wayar fiye da kima” zuwa tambayar da za a bincika
x-m-el-res-01.goal: Don mayar da batu marar takamaiman bayani zuwa tambayar da za a iya tabbatarwa da bayanai, tantance abin da dole ne a yanke kafin tattara bayanai.
x-m-el-res-01.material: Wani ɗalibi a ƙungiya ya zaɓi “ɗaliban makarantarmu suna amfani da wayoyinsu fiye da kima” a matsayin batun bincike. Malami ya ce, “Da wannan jimlar kamar yadda take, ba za ku iya yin bincike ko fassara sakamakon ba.”
x-m-el-res-01.thinking.1: Mayar da kalmomi marasa takamaiman ma’ana zuwa kalmomin da za a iya aunawa
x-m-el-res-01.prereq.0: Sanin ma’anar matsakaita da kaso (matakin makarantar tsakiya)
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk abin da dole ne a tantance kafin tattara bayanai.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo sassan furucin “fiye da kima” da mutane biyu za su iya fahimta ta hanyoyi daban-daban.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane abu, ka yi tunanin ko masu bincike biyu da suka gudanar da bincike iri ɗaya daban-daban za su iya samun sakamako daban idan ba a bayyana wannan ba.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.o.a: Wa za a bincika: duk ɗalibai, aji guda ko aji ɗaya
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka manta cewa idan ba a tantance rukunin ba, ba za mu san waɗanda sakamakon ya shafa ba.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.o.b: Yadda za a auna “da yawa”: sa’o’i a rana ko yawan kunna wayar
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.r.b: Idan ba a tantance ƙimar da za a auna “da yawa” da ita ba, mutane daban-daban za su binciki abubuwa daban-daban.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.o.c: Ma’aunin “fiye da kima”: daga sa’o’i nawa ake cewa amfani ya yi yawa
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.r.c: Idan ba a saita ma’auni ba, bayanai iri ɗaya za su iya zama “da yawa” ko “kaɗan” dukansu.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.o.d: Saita jumlar ƙarshe da za a rubuta a rahoto kafin a samu sakamakon
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.r.d: Idan aka riga aka yanke hukuncin ƙarshe, zai yi sauƙi a karkatar da bayanai zuwa wannan hukunci. Abin da ya kamata a tantance shi ne tambaya da ma’auni.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.o.e: Tantance launuka da nau’in rubutu na kayan gabatarwa tun da wuri
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.r.e: Ado ba shi da alaƙa sosai da ingancin bincike. Ka mai da hankali ga abin da ake aunawa da yadda ake aunawa.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.explain: Sai an tantance rukuni, hanyar aunawa, ma’auni (da lokacin) ne wani mutum zai iya amsa tambaya iri ɗaya ta hanya ɗaya. Ya kamata a rubuta hukuncin ƙarshe bayan an ga bayanai.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s1.acc.0: Ana iya tantance ma’aunin “fiye da kima” bayan tattara bayanai ma. Amma tantance shi tun farko yana hana sauya ma’auni bayan an ga sakamakon.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.prompt: Haɗa duk abubuwan da ka zaɓa a sama, ka sake rubuta batun a matsayin jimlar tambaya guda ɗaya da za a iya bincika. (A bayyana rukuni, hanyar aunawa, lokacin ko ma’auni.)
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.hint.0: Duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko jimlar ta ƙunshi “waye,” “an auna da me,” “a wane lokaci,” da “daga wace ƙima.”
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.hint.1: Mayar da kalmomin da mutane ke fahimta dabam-dabam, kamar “da yawa,” zuwa lambobi.
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: An haɗa rukuni, hanyar aunawa, da lokacin da ma’auni duka a cikin jimlar?
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wani mutum zai iya karanta tambayarka ya gudanar da bincike iri ɗaya?
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: An mayar da kalmomin yanke hukunci kamar “fiye da kima” da “da yawa” zuwa ma’aunin lambobi?
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.model.0: Ga ɗaliban shekara ta 2 a makarantarmu, menene matsakaicin sa’o’in amfani da wayar hannu a ranar makaranta, kuma kaso nawa na ɗalibai ke amfani da ita na sa’o’i 3 ko fiye?
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.model.1: A cikin ɗaliban ajinmu, kaso nawa ne matsakaicin amfani da wayarsu a rana a makon da ya gabata ya wuce sa’o’i 4?
x-m-el-res-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: An rage rukunin zuwa aji ɗaya, amma an fayyace ma’aunin.

x-m-el-res-02.title: Za Mu Iya Yanke Hukunci daga Wannan Tsarin Bincike?
x-m-el-res-02.goal: Nemo sassan tsarin binciken da ke raunana hukuncinsa, sannan ka ba da shawarar gyare-gyaren da za su sa ya zama abin dogaro.
x-m-el-res-02.material: Wani ɗalibi yana son gano “ko yin dogon karatun dare yana ƙara maki,” sai ya tsara binciken da ke ƙasa.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda da ke sa hukuncin ƙarshe ya zama marar tabbas. (Lambobin layi suna farawa daga 1.)
x-m-el-res-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta a sarari, layi bayan layi, abin da kowanne layi ya tantance ko ya ɗauka a matsayin hukunci, sannan ka duba ko hujjar ta isa.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko karatun dare ne kaɗai dalilin ƙarin maki, ko kuma akwai wasu yiwuwar dalilai.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s1.line.0: Tambayar bincike: Shin ɗaliban da suke zama don karatun dare suna samun maki mafi girma?
x-m-el-res-02.s.s1.line.1: Rukuni: ɗalibai 20 da suke halartar karatun dare
x-m-el-res-02.s.s1.line.2: Hanya: Nemo bambanci tsakanin makin jarrabawar tsakiyar zangon da ta ƙarshen zangon wannan zangon karatu.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s1.line.3: Tsarin hukunci: Idan makin ɗaliban da suka halarta ya ƙaru a matsakaici, a rubuta “karatun dare yana ƙara maki.”
x-m-el-res-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ba ya kwatanta da ɗaliban da ba sa halarta, don haka ba za mu san ko ƙarin maki yana faruwa ga sauran ɗalibai ma ba. A layi na 3, idan jarrabawar biyu sun bambanta da wahala, yana da wuya a kwatanta sauyin maki kai tsaye. Layi na 4 kuma nan take ya ɗauki ƙarin maki a matsayin sanadi. Dukkansu suna raunana hukuncin ƙarshe.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi sashe guda da za a gyara, ka rubuta yadda sauya shi zai sa hukuncin ya fi zama abin dogaro.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta lambar layi ko abin da za ka gyara, sannan ka rubuta tsarin da aka sauya.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙara jimla guda da ke nuna tambayar da sabon tsarin zai amsa.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Sashen da ka gyara yana da alaƙa da dalilin da hukuncin ba shi da tabbaci?
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka duba ko har yanzu akwai wani abu a sabon tsarin da zai hana ka bayyana sanadi kai tsaye?
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.model.0: Nemo sauyin maki ta hanya iri ɗaya ga ɗalibai 20 da ba sa halartar karatun dare, ka kwatanta, sannan ka ce akwai alaƙa ne kawai idan makin masu halarta ya ƙaru fiye da nasu.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.model.1: Dole a gyara layi na 4. Ƙarin makin na iya kasancewa saboda wasu dalilai kamar wahalar jarrabawa ko karatun mutum shi kaɗai, saboda haka a tsaya da cewa “maki sun ƙaru” kawai, kada a tabbatar da sanadin.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wannan hanya ce ta gyara yadda aka furta hukuncin ƙarshe.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.model.2: A haɗa ɗalibai 20 da ba sa halartar karatun dare, sannan a kwatanta sauyin makinsu a jarrabawa guda biyu iri ɗaya. Ta haka za a iya cire ƙarin maki da zai faru ko ba tare da halarta ba, sannan a duba tasirin karatun dare.
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.model.3: A layin hanyar bincike, wahalar jarrabawa biyu na iya bambanta; saboda haka a kwatanta ta amfani da makin da aka daidaita da ma’auni iri ɗaya (makin ma’auni).
x-m-el-res-02.s.s2.modelNote.3: Wannan ita ce hanyar gyara layi na 3.

x-m-el-res-06.title: Mun Rasa Ɗaya Daga Cikin Tushen Daidaito Bayan Raba
x-m-el-res-06.goal: Nemo matakin warware daidaito inda aka rasa tushen, ka bayyana dalili, sannan ka warware shi daidai.
x-m-el-res-06.material: Wani ɗalibi ya warware daidaiton x² = x (x murabba’i daidai yake da x) kamar haka.
x-m-el-res-06.prereq.0: Iya warware daidaiton murabba’i mai sauƙi kamar x²=x (matakin makarantar tsakiya)
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda da ya sa warwarewar ba abin dogaro ba ce. (Lambobin layi suna farawa daga 1.)
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ƙimar da wata magana ba za ta iya ɗauka ba idan ka raba ɓangarorin biyu da ita.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bambance ko layi na 3 yana nuna kawai cewa “1 mafita ce” ko kuma “1 kaɗai ce mafita.”
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.line.1: Raba ɓangarorin biyu da x, a samu x = 1.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.line.2: Saka x = 1 yana ba da 1 = 1, saboda haka daidaiton ya cika.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka mafita ita ce x = 1 kaɗai.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.explain: A layi na 2, domin a raba ɓangarorin biyu da magana iri ɗaya, dole ne maganar ba ta zama 0 ba. Da aka raba ba tare da bincika wannan ba, ba za a amince da ƙarshe cewa “ɗaya kaɗai” a layi na 4 ba. Layi na 3 daidai ne, amma bai nuna cewa babu wasu mafita ba.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.prompt: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa wannan warwarewar take da matsala, sannan ka rubuta dukkan mafita daidai.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.hint.0: Gwada ƙimomin x domin gano wacce take sa rabawar layi na 2 ba ta yiwuwa.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ka gwada matsar da komai gefe guda zuwa x²−x=0, ka warware ba tare da rabawa ba.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Bayyanarka ta faɗi “sharadin da ake buƙata yayin rabawa” kuwa?
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka tabbatar ta hanyar maye gurbin mafita cikin daidaiton asali bayan gyaran warwarewarka?
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.model.0: Idan x ya zama 0, hakan kamar raba da 0 ne, wanda ba a yarda ba. Tunda x²−x=0, x(x−1)=0, saboda haka x=0 ko x=1.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.model.1: Kafin rabawa, dole ne a duba yanayin x=0 shi kaɗai. x=0 yana cika daidaiton, don haka mafita biyu su ne 0 da 1.

x-m-el-res-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ko domin wannan kwatanci ya zama abin dogaro, dole ne a samu ƙimomin ta hanyar tambaya ɗaya kuma ta hanya ɗaya.

x-m-el-res-10.s.s1.o.a: Yadda aka zaɓi masu amsa 10 daga Aji A.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s1.r.a: Yadda aka zaɓi masu amsa yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da ko sakamakon yana wakiltar aji gaba ɗaya.

x-m-el-res-10.s.s1.r.b: Ka zaɓi bayanin da ba shi da alaƙa sosai da ƙimar amincewa.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s1.o.c: Ko tunanin mutane 10 da ba su amsa ba tukuna ya yi kama da na mutane 10 da suka amsa.

x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.prompt: Idan x daga cikin sauran ɗalibai 10 na Aji A suka amince, adadin masu amincewa a dukkan Aji A (ɗalibai 20) zai zama 7+x. Nemo darajoji 3 daban-daban na x da za su sa ƙimar amincewar ajin ta zama 65% ko ƙasa da ƙimar makarantar baki ɗaya.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo adadin masu amincewa a duk Aji A da zai sa ƙimar ta zama 65% ko ƙasa.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.hint.1: Cire mutane 7 da suka riga suka amince daga wannan adadi don sanin iyakar x.

x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙimar amincewar duk Aji A ta kai 65% ko ƙasa da haka.

x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.explain: Ƙimar amincewar ɗalibai 20 na Aji A ita ce (7+x)÷20. Idan x ya kai 6 ko ƙasa, ƙimar za ta zama 65% ko ƙasa, kuma furucin cewa ya fi makarantar ya juya. Ƙarshe na iya canzawa dangane da amsoshin sauran mutane 10.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta yadda ya kamata a sake fasalta furucin cewa ƙimar amincewar Aji A ta fi ta makarantar baki ɗaya bisa wannan sakamako.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin irin tasirin da sauran mutane 10 za su iya yi a kan sakamako idan amsoshi 10 kawai ake da su.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.because.hint.1: Duba ko jumlar da ka sake rubutawa ta ƙunshi dalilin da ya sa ba za mu iya tabbatar da hakan ba.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Shin jumlarka ta tsaya cikin iyakar bayanan da kake da su yanzu?
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka ambaci cewa sakamakon na iya canzawa dangane da amsoshin da suka rage?
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.because.model.0: Mutane 10 ne kawai suka amsa, saboda haka sakamakon na iya canzawa bisa amsoshin sauran 10, don haka yana da wuya a tabbatar cewa Aji A ya fi.
x-m-el-res-10.s.s2.because.model.1: Da ƙaramin samfurin bincike, ƙarshe na iya juyawa. Idan amsoshi kaɗan suka bambanta, tsarin 70% da 65% na iya musanya, saboda haka ba za mu iya tabbatar cewa Aji A ya fi ba.

x-m-el-res-08.topic: Hanya da ɗabi'a (tushen bayanai, karkatar da sakamako)
x-m-el-res-08.title: Duba Tsarin A cikin Daftarin Rahoto
x-m-el-res-08.goal: Nemo kurakurai wajen ambaton tushen bayanai da zaɓen bayanai a daftarin rahoton bincike, sannan ka zaɓi hanyar da ta dace ta kula da sakamakon da ya bambanta da tsammani.
x-m-el-res-08.material: Wani ɗalibi da ke rubuta daftarin rahoton bincike game da lokacin barci ya sarrafa bayanan kamar haka.
x-m-el-res-08.prereq.0: Ɗan gogewa wajen gudanar da bincike.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda mai matsala a tsarin binciken. (Lambobin layi suna farawa daga 1.)
x-m-el-res-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ko mai karatu zai iya duba tushen bayanai da yanayin da aka tattara su daga wannan layi kaɗai.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko an yanke shawarar ƙa'idar zaɓen bayanai kafin a ga sakamakon.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s1.line.0: An kwafi teburin lokacin barcin matasa da aka samu a intanet yadda yake, ba a rubuta tushensa ba saboda kowa zai iya ganin bayanan.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s1.line.1: Ga binciken ajinmu, an rubuta ranar binciken, adadin mutane da jumlar tambayar a rahoto.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s1.line.2: Tun da sakamakon ya bambanta da hasashe, an zaɓi amsoshin azuzuwa biyu kawai da suka dace da hasashen, sannan aka bincika su.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s1.line.3: Game da bayanan wata makaranta, an rubuta ƙungiyar da shekara, sannan aka bayyana cewa hanyar binciken ta bambanta da tamu.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 bai faɗi wanda ya tattara bayanan ba, don haka mai karatu ba zai iya tantance su ba; kamar an yi amfani da bayanan wani a matsayin na mutum. A layi na 3 an ƙirƙiri sakamakon ta hanyar zaɓen bayanan da suka dace da hasashe kawai. Layuka na 2 da na 4 sun bayyana yanayin tattarawa, don haka mai karatu zai iya tantance su.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.prompt: Ka binciki amsoshin duk azuzuwan kuma hasashen bai samu goyon baya ba. Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa wajen sarrafa wannan sakamako?
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.hint.0: Duba ko kowace zaɓi tana nuna wa mai karatu sakamakon farko yadda yake.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ka tuna cewa sakamakon da ba ya goyon bayan hasashe ma bayani ne.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.o.a: Hasashen ba zai iya zama kuskure ba, don haka ka rubuta cewa tambayoyin binciken ba su da kyau sannan ka cire sakamakon.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.r.a: Ka watsar da sakamakon saboda ba ka so.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.o.b: Yi amfani da duk sakamakon yadda suke, ka bayyana cewa hasashen bai samu goyon baya ba, sannan ka binciki dalilan.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.r.b: Wannan yana nufin karɓar sakamakon da ya bambanta da tsammani a matsayin wani bayani ma.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.o.c: Ajiye azuzuwan da suka dace da hasashen kawai, sannan ka cire amsoshin sauran azuzuwan daga rahoto.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.r.c: Sakamakon ne ya zama ƙa'idar zaɓen bayanai.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.o.d: Sanya sakamakon da ya bambanta da hasashe ƙanana sosai a ƙarshen teburin, sannan ka yi bayanin sassan da suka dace da hasashe kawai.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.r.d: Ba ka ɓoye sakamakon ba, amma ka sanya shi a wurin da mai karatu zai iya kasa lura da shi.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.o.e: Da farko ka bayar da rahoton duk sakamakon, sannan ka sake bincike da tambaya iri ɗaya kuma ka haɗa duka sakamakon.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.r.e: Wannan yana nufin a riƙe sakamakon farko sannan a yi ƙarin dubawa.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.explain: Bincike yana nufin bayar da rahoton sakamako yadda yake ko da ya bambanta da hasashe, tare da binciken dalilan da za su iya jawo hakan. Za ka iya sake gudanar da bincike, amma dole ne ka nuna sakamakon farko ma.
x-m-el-res-08.s.s2.acc.0: Hanya ce ta gaskiya idan ka haɗa sakamakon farko ba tare da ɓoye shi ba, tare da sakamakon sabon bincike.
